mapper.sql: o.id, o.order_no, o.user_id, o.total_amount, o.pay_amount, o.status, o.pay_type, o.pay_time, o.delivery_time, o.receive_time, o.close_time, o.remark, o.receiver_name, o.receiver_phone, o.receiver_address, o.logistics_no, o.logistics_company, o.create_time, o.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.username FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.id = #{id}
SELECT , u.username FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON o.user_id = u.id WHERE o.order_no = #{orderNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, total_amount, pay_amount, status, pay_type, pay_time, delivery_time, receive_time, close_time, remark, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, logistics_no, logistics_company) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{payAmount}, #{status}, #{payType}, #{payTime}, #{deliveryTime}, #{receiveTime}, #{closeTime}, #{remark}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{logisticsNo}, #{logisticsCompany})
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = 4, close_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1)
